name: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
short: Google's only 3.1 Flash text SKU (GA 2026-05-07, 1M/65K) - Google never shipped a bare 'Gemini 3.1 Flash'; GPQA 82.2%, LiveCodeBench 72-80%. Folder parked: research lives in gemini-3.1-flash-lite.
modalities: Text, image, audio, video, PDF in; text out
pricingTiers: Free tier available on AI Studio with standard rate limits
freeTierNote: Free tier available on Google AI Studio with standard rate limits (NOT on OpenCode Zen: Zen's Gemini catalogue starts at Gemini 3 Flash and carries no 3.1 Flash-Lite route)
standout: The balanced 3.1 Flash: solid coding scores with a free AI Studio lane for everyday speed/cost trade-offs.
tradeoff: Overshadowed by the 3.5–3.8 Flash revisions, which raised capability at similar prices.
